english.title: Aid abet counsel and procure a person in the possession / custody of a dog whilst disqualified
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), aided, abetted, counselled and procured, **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to have custody of a dog in contravention of an order of **(..SPECIFY THE COURT..) made on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE..) under section 4(1)(b) of the Dangerous Dogs Act 1991 which disqualified

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

from having custody of a dog for **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(8)(a) of the Dangerous Dogs Act 1991 and section 44 of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
